primitives.name: RF to Signal Processing Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: This report presents a functional description of signal processing in the Rogue receiver, tracing the signal from RF input to the output values of group delay, phase, and data bits.
primitives.assumptions: Linear signal propagation; no interference between channels; stable oscillator reference.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB or loss of lock on >3 satellites.

layer2.mapping: Each RF channel maps to a distinct set of group delay and phase estimates through matched filtering and correlation.
layer2.telemetry: Satellite lock indicator, phase lock loop status, and residual error metrics.

primitives.name: Multi-Satellite Tracking Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: The receiver can track up to eight satellites, without time multiplexing among satellites or channels, simultaneously measuring both group delay and phase for each of three channels (L1-C/A, L1-P, L2-P).
primitives.assumptions: Independent satellite signals; no cross-talk between channels; constant Doppler shift during integration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Tracking loss when >8 satellites are visible or signal overlap exceeds processing capacity.

layer2.mapping: Parallel processing of up to 8 satellites per channel enables multi-satellite state estimation via Kalman filtering.
layer2.telemetry: Number of tracked satellites, channel lock status, and average group delay variance.

primitives.name: Code Generation Module
primitives.verbatim_quote: The Rogue signal processing described in this report requires generation of the code for all three channels.
primitives.assumptions: Precise pseudorandom code synchronization; fixed chip rate across all channels.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Loss of code lock due to timing drift exceeding 1 chip width or excessive noise.

layer2.mapping: Generated codes enable coherent correlation with incoming signals for phase and delay estimation.
layer2.telemetry: Code lock indicator, correlation peak amplitude, and timing offset estimate.
